name: Foo Is Missing
description:
About This Game

Rewind your position. Rewrite the fight. In a neon-drenched cyberpunk metropolis, use “Rollback” to snap back to your location from seconds earlier and conquer gimmick-heavy stages. It’s more than a second chance—Rollback fuels tactical action, whether you’re going on the offensive or making a clean getaway.

This is a 2D action game set in a cyberpunk world. Use the "rollback" ability, which allows you to teleport　to a previous position, to solve stages packed with various challenges. The ability to instantly return to past coordinates can be used to recover from mistakes or for attacks, depending on your imagination. A variety of unique enemy characters appear, making for exhilarating battles.
